scope: Proposition 3.6 of the manuscript “Termination for projective log canonical fourfolds with rational boundary” (preprints/Termination-for-projective-log-canonical-fourfolds-with-rational-boundary-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ac06a1f5c9a11c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After truncating the small downstairs tail, every surface contained in either bad locus of every remaining step has generic-point mld greater than one and is generically in the smooth locus of its ambient model. At each remaining crepant junction, every varying label has downstairs center of codimension at least three. Consequently the reduced union of varying labels is mapped by pi to a set of dimension at most one.
